home.title: Cryptography Research Group
home.subtitle: Jinan University · School of Cyber Science and Technology
home.intro1: Led by Prof. Lai Junzuo and Dr. Liu Yi, our group focuses on cutting-edge research in
home.intro1End: , conducting in-depth research in areas such as large language model security, zero-knowledge proofs, public-key cryptographic schemes, and blockchain applications.
home.intro2Start: We are committed to cultivating cybersecurity talents with international perspectives and innovative capabilities. We welcome outstanding students interested in cryptography and AI security to join us. The group recruits
home.intro2End: year-round, providing members with excellent research environment, international exchange opportunities, and career development support.

research.title: Research Areas
research.description: Our group focuses on frontier issues in cyberspace security, conducting in-depth research in AI security, cognitive security, cryptography and related fields.
research.collaborationDesc: We welcome academic exchanges and collaborative research with universities and research institutions worldwide. If you are interested in collaboration, please contact us via email.

team.title: Team Members
team.description: Our group consists of faculty members, postdocs, PhD students, and Master's students

students.title: Graduate Programs
students.phdDesc: We provide comprehensive research training and academic guidance for applicants with strong research capabilities and academic interests.
students.masterDesc: We welcome students interested in cyberspace security, offering systematic research training and project practice opportunities.
students.undergradDesc: Outstanding undergraduates are welcome to participate in research internships and get early exposure to cutting-edge research.
students.req1: • Passionate about research with strong learning ability and self-motivation
students.req2: • Background in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, AI, Cryptography, Mathematics or related fields
students.req3: • Good programming skills and English reading/writing abilities
students.req4: • Priority given to those with relevant research experience or competition awards
students.contactDesc: Interested students please contact us via email with your CV, transcripts, and representative achievements (if any).

postdoc.title: Postdoctoral Positions
postdoc.dir1Desc: Including LLM jailbreaking and prompt injection, poisoning and backdoors, hallucination and safety alignment, security evaluation, multimodal and agent security, etc.
postdoc.dir2Desc: Including misinformation and deepfake detection, content authenticity and traceability, social media information manipulation, LLM-driven cognitive security attacks and defenses, etc.
postdoc.dir3Desc: Including various post-quantum public-key cryptography and digital signatures, post-quantum cryptographic protocols and their security analysis and efficient implementation, etc.
postdoc.dirNote: Specific research topics can be determined jointly based on the applicant's research background and interests.
postdoc.qual1: • Obtained or will obtain PhD degree soon, generally within 3 years after obtaining PhD, age generally not exceeding 35
postdoc.qual2: • Research background in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, AI, Cryptography, Mathematics or related fields
postdoc.qual3: • Strong research foundation and representative achievements in relevant research areas
postdoc.qual4: • Strong independent research capability and development potential, able to conduct full-time postdoctoral research
postdoc.qualNote: Priority given to those with high-level representative papers or highly aligned with the above key directions.
postdoc.salaryDesc1: According to Jinan University's current postdoctoral policy, the basic support from the university and supervisor team for full-time postdocs in natural sciences is approximately
postdoc.salaryDesc2: In addition to the university's existing compensation, the team can provide additional support based on the applicant's research background, position match, and performance.
postdoc.salaryDesc3: Outstanding postdocs can receive comprehensive support exceeding 500,000 RMB/year, with specific compensation negotiable.
postdoc.benefit1: • Same medical benefits as university faculty
postdoc.benefit2: • Children can attend university-affiliated kindergartens and schools
postdoc.benefit3: • Can apply for senior professional titles during the postdoc period, with separate evaluation
postdoc.appDesc: Please send the following materials to the specified email:
postdoc.appItem2: • Representative papers and other research achievements
postdoc.appItem3: • Brief research plan or intended research direction
